test_item_verbatim: · The Head Unit shall gate FD-CAN8 BRAKE_FD_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig to LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig

tcs.tc_title: gate VehicleSpeedVSOSig to VehicleSpeedVSOSig, set the CAN signal and read vehicleUpdate_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. A bus analyzer is connected to the LVDS link between the HU and the RVCM
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: BRAKE_FD_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig = 205 (12.8125 km/h)
2. Read vehicleUpdate_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig and check that it reports the value sent in step 1
tcs.expected_result:
1. BRAKE_FD_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig = 205 (12.8125 km/h) is sent
2. vehicleUpdate_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig reports the same value and is sent over LVDS
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item:
· The Head Unit shall gate FD-CAN8 BRAKE_FD_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig to LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig

(gate VehicleSpeedVSOSig to VehicleSpeedVSOSig, set the CAN signal and read vehicleUpdate_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 `SYS-RA-VF551_V2-461` 之「HU 將 FD-CAN8 `BRAKE_FD_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig` gate 至 LVDS `vehicleUpdate_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig`」。供試 raw 205 = 12.8125 km/h（factor (0.0625,0) "Km/h"，`BO_ 258`）。缺失側由 `NR1L-RVC-151` 承接。LVDS 訊號無 DBC（四本零命中），其值以來源 label 逐字書寫、觀察以 bus analyzer 進行，**不造命令**（profile §7.2／§7.3）。
